meta.description: Quality control for bottom-up proteomics across instrument, identification, and experiment levels, including raw-first loading checks, contamination, matrix reproducibility, batch/PCA, TMT balance, and DIA-NN Level-1 metrics.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All numerical findings were generated from the archived synthetic controls, the archived DIA-NN report, or explicitly labelled derived fixtures; none were presented as clinical or experimental findings.

practice_boundaries.detail: The runs provide QC diagnostics and stop conditions, not patient-specific diagnosis, treatment, or sample exclusion without approval.

methodological_ground.detail: Fresh tests confirmed raw-before-normalization, linear-scale CV, log2 correlation, no-replicate status handling, and the fully-confounded batch stop condition.

code_usability.detail: All shipped Python files compiled. The four scripts, seeded example, and the inline TMT block executed; the DIA-NN CLI correctly runs on a conformant fixture but lacks a friendly preflight for a real report missing three required columns.

functional_suitability.note: The three-level QC workflow, decisions, thresholds, reporting template, and all advertised helper scripts are present; the DIA-NN Level-1 route is not compatible with the archived real report without required-column validation.

reliability.note: Explicit statuses, stop conditions, deterministic full-SVD PCA, and warnings cover key degenerate designs, but diann_level1 exposes a raw KeyError rather than naming missing columns and an alternative route.

performance_context.note: The concise SKILL.md delegates detailed matrix, PCA, DIA-NN, and reporting material to references and uses small deterministic helpers.

agent_usability.note: Clear raw-first sequence, decision tree, output columns, threshold rationale, common errors, and escalation conditions make the workflow usable from a cold start.

human_usability.note: The usage guide has concrete requests and the QC report template records flags, approvals, and sensitivity checks without duplicating the operational instructions.

security.note: No secrets, destructive operations, or user-code execution are present; file/schema preflight is incomplete for the DIA-NN CLI.

maintainability.note: Four single-purpose scripts, their headers/CLIs, reference routing, reproducible example, and status-bearing data frames cleanly separate concerns.

agent_specific.note: Trigger language and scope boundaries are precise; progressive disclosure and status columns support composition, with the DIA-NN input contract remaining a minor escape-hatch gap.

inputs.label: Raw-first MaxQuant matrix QC before normalization
inputs.execution_note: Freshly executed raw_qc.py, matrix_metrics.py, pca_batch.py, and the copied branch helpers on the archived synthetic MaxQuant data. Results are in run/phase2_final_20260923/phase2_dynamic.out and the three CLI logs.
inputs.note: 1,500 contaminant-filtered rows yielded 12 measured replicate pairs, Control/Treatment median CVs 24.27%/23.57%, and three tested batch-PC rows.

assertions.text: Raw-first loading, correlation, CV, missingness, completeness, and PCA all execute
assertions.note: All six workflow outputs were nonempty.

assertions.text: Replicate correlation uses measurable status-bearing rows
assertions.note: 12 rows, all status=measured.

assertions.text: Linear-scale CV output is present by condition
assertions.note: Control 24.27% and Treatment 23.57%.

assertions.text: Balanced batch association is evaluated rather than assumed
assertions.note: PC1-PC3 test statuses were tested.

inputs.label: PTXQC createReport with and without Pandoc
inputs.execution_note: Fresh R 4.4.3/PTXQC 1.1.5 runs used saved ptxqc_no_pandoc.R and ptxqc_with_pandoc.R through the approved r.sh wrapper. Outputs and logs are retained in the phase2 run folder.
inputs.note: Without Pandoc, PTXQC produced PDF, mzQC, YAML, and an 8x13 heatmap but no HTML. With RSTUDIO_PANDOC set, it additionally produced a 1,367.4 kB HTML report.

assertions.text: The exact documented createReport(txt_folder=...) call completes
assertions.note: Both runs exited successfully and emitted reports.

assertions.text: Pandoc is not required for the PDF/mzQC/YAML leg
assertions.note: All three artifacts existed with pandoc_available=FALSE.

assertions.text: Pandoc enables the HTML leg
assertions.note: HTML existed only with RSTUDIO_PANDOC configured.

assertions.text: PTXQC QC scores are inspectable
assertions.note: The generated heatmap table parsed as 8x13.

inputs.label: DIA-NN Level-1 report QC
inputs.execution_note: The shipped diann_level1.py was run directly on the archived real report.parquet and on a separately labelled conformant fixture made from that report. Both CLI logs and the fixture are retained in the phase2 run folder.
inputs.note: The archived real report has Run, RT, and Global.Q.Value but lacks Predicted.RT, FWHM, and Quantity.Quality; the direct CLI therefore raises KeyError ['Predicted.RT', 'FWHM']. The same shipped code returned eight no-flag rows on the conformant fixture.

assertions.text: The actual report schema is checked by a fresh direct execution
assertions.note: The CLI failed reproducibly at the missing-column access.

assertions.text: The documented helper computes per-run R2, FWHM, and flag on a conformant report
assertions.note: Eight runs returned R2=1.0 and no flags from the labelled fixture.

assertions.text: The real DIA-NN failure is clear and actionable to a user
assertions.note: Raw KeyError lists only Predicted.RT and FWHM; it does not preflight all required columns or name an alternative input route.

assertions.text: No derived fixture result is presented as a real QC conclusion
assertions.note: Fixture data and results are explicitly labelled synthetic/conformant.

inputs.label: Fully confounded batch and condition

inputs.note: The crosstab was exactly day1=4 Control/day2=4 Treatment. PCA can describe the separation; the Skill correctly directs the analyst to report non-identifiability and stop rather than correct/test.

assertions.text: The stress design is actually fully confounded
assertions.note: Each batch contained one condition only.

assertions.text: PCA can report association without claiming correction is valid
assertions.note: Three PC tests executed.

assertions.text: The Skill names the non-identifiability stop condition
assertions.note: Its PCA reference says do not correct and do not test.

assertions.text: No batch-corrected result is advanced as a valid differential test
assertions.note: The audited workflow stopped at QC interpretation.

inputs.label: Two controls plus two singleton groups

assertions.note: Control produced one measured correlation and CV row.

inputs.label: All-singleton three-condition design
inputs.execution_note: A fresh three-sample, three-group design was run through all relevant helpers in phase2_dynamic.py.
inputs.note: Replicate correlation and linear CV both raised explicit not-measurable errors, all loading rules fell back to ALL, and PCA returned only not_testable rows.

assertions.text: No-replicate correlation fails loudly
assertions.note: replicate_correlation raised a group-size error.

assertions.text: No-replicate CV fails loudly
assertions.note: median_cv_linear raised a not-measurable error.

assertions.text: The loading fallback is not silently within-group
assertions.note: Every row says fallback_all_samples.

assertions.text: PCA outputs a machine-readable design limitation
assertions.note: Both returned PC test rows were not_testable.

key_strengths: The raw-first rule demonstrably catches a T4 loading failure that normalized MaxLFQ hides.
Phase 1's status-bearing outputs correctly preserve partial and total no-replicate design limits for callers.
The sample-swap, deterministic PCA, TMT balance, and fully-confounded batch safeguards all reproduced in fresh runs.
PTXQC behavior with and without Pandoc exactly matches the documented decision-tree and common-error guidance.

recommendations.title: Preflight the DIA-NN Level-1 column contract
recommendations.problem: The archived real DIA-NN report.parquet lacks Predicted.RT, FWHM, and Quantity.Quality. diann_level1.py crashes with a raw KeyError that lists only two missing columns, although the skill describes these as report-carried metrics.
recommendations.root_cause: The helper accesses columns before validating the report schema or explaining which acquisition/export route supplies them.
recommendations.fix: Add an explicit required-column preflight listing Run, RT, Predicted.RT, FWHM, Quantity.Quality, and Global.Q.Value. When unavailable, raise a clear ValueError that labels Level-1 RT/FWHM QC unavailable for that export and routes the user to the vendor/run-metrics export instead of implying the standard report contains the fields.
